findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation "Give every custom control an accessible name and the correct role and state" lacks a specific data anchor (no selector, page URL or instance count).
Priority 2 recommendation "Raise the contrast ratio of the flagged text and its background" is generic and not tied to any specific element or instance from the audit.
Priority 3 recommendation "Make every id attribute unique within each page" does not reference a particular ID, selector or count from the audit data.
Priority 4 recommendation "Add descriptive alt text to every informative image" is a domain-level suggestion without any specific image selector or instance count.
Priority 5 recommendation "Expose the structure a sighted user sees (headings, lists, tables, form labels) in the markup" lacks a concrete data anchor from this audit.
Priority 6 recommendation "Add a skip link as the first focusable element" is generic and not tied to any specific page or selector.
Priority 7 recommendation "Order headings without skipping levels" does not reference any particular heading instance or count from the audit.

Priority 8 recommendation "Replace obvious landmark containers with semantic elements and give remaining containers meaningful class names" is a generic suggestion without specific selectors or page references.
Priority 9 recommendation "Profile the slow route with server-side tooling" does not include any specific URL, selector or instance count from this audit.
Priority 10 recommendation "Add missing response headers at the server or CDN edge" is a domain-level instruction without referencing any particular header name or page.
Priority 11 recommendation "Complete the flagged SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical)" lacks specific data anchors from this audit.
Priority 12 recommendation "Add missing required and recommended Schema.org properties to the flagged entity types" is generic and not tied to any specific property instance or selector.
Priority 13 recommendation "Add missing required and recommended Schema.org properties to the flagged entity types" repeats the same generic suggestion without a data anchor.
Priority 14 recommendation "Publish the missing discovery file at the site root" is a domain-level instruction with no specific URL or selector from this audit.
